d: Om Puri was a veteran Indian actor who was a part of mainstream Indian films as well as several art films. He also appeared in British and American films. Puri graduated from the Film and Television Institute of India (FTII). He was an alumnus of the 1973 batch of National School of Drama where Naseeruddin Shah was his batch-mate. In 1990, Puri was awarded Padma Shri and in 2004 he was made an honorary Officer of the Order of the British Empire.
